reviewItem.question: For "Split apart PackageRuntime setting into functions and providers by @n3wscott in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6567", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: the config location and exact key name of the PackageRuntime setting (Helm values key, CLI flag, or feature gate), so environments that set it can be detected

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 splits the single PackageRuntime setting into separate settings for functions and providers, so the combined setting no longer exists, per a one-line release note that does not name the new settings, say where PackageRuntime is configured, or state what happens to existing configurations.
